title: Prioritize stop sentinels and logprob fanout for v1 parity
author: Samir Kapoor
description: Motivation: customers expect /v1/chat.completions parity for stop handling and token-level logprobs while retaining our streaming stability and tool/fncall guarantees. This PR introduces a deterministic stop-sentinel prioritizer plus an early logprob fanout path so per-chunk logprob information is delivered to the OpenAI-compatible v1 stream without increasing tail latency. Changes are conservative and gated behind a feature flag to enable staged rollout and A/B. What this PR does: 1) Stop sentinel prioritizer: canonicalizes stop token formats (string, string array, regex-like heuristics) and adds a priority table so explicit stop arrays > role-based stop heuristics > runtime fallback. This prevents ambiguous stop matches during the streaming window and reduces duplicated stop events. 2) Logprob fanout: extracts logprob scores at the streaming fragment boundary and fans them out as a small metadata envelope so clients receiving chunked deltas can reconstruct token-level probabilities without waiting for final completion. 3) Tool/function-call boundary fix: strengthens the stream handshake so a partial tool call finish will not be interpreted as a stop event; toolcall completion signals are now orthogonal to stop arbitration. 4) Param translation updates: expands v1 param normalization to preserve stop arrays and explicit role metadata while mapping deprecated keys to the new normalized fields. 5) Tests and observability: new e2e scenarios, unit tests for stop priority, and tracing spans for logprob fanout and boundary arbitration. Rollout plan: feature-flagged rollout to canary, metric monitoring for duplicate-stop incidents and stream replays, then broad enablement. Backcompat notes: behavior is opt-in while the feature flag is off; when enabled there is a subtle change in how overlapping stop rules are resolved (explicit stops win). Performance: microbench shows ~0.6% median throughput regression in extreme short-seq workloads due to the extra fanout envelope; tail latency unchanged. Related work: ENG-1298 (v1 compatibility backlog), ENG-2145 (streaming stability), PM-87 (tooling UX).

release_notes: Opt-in v1 parity for stop resolution and early per-chunk logprobs. Feature flag enabled for canary; intended to reduce duplicate stop events in streaming v1 clients.
notes_on_rollout: Feature gated. Enable on canary for 48h, monitor compat.stop_overlap, streaming.replay_rate, and p99 token latency. If no regressions, promote to 25% then 100%.
performance_summary: Microbench: median throughput -0.6% on short sequences, tail latency unchanged; end-to-end e2e unchanged for typical 512-token workloads.
